📢 AIIMS Mangalagiri Various Posts Online Form 2026

All India Institute of Medical Sciences Mangalagiri (AIIMS Mangalagiri) has released the notification for 28 Senior Resident/Senior Demonstrator posts. Eligible candidates can apply online at aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in till 21 November 2026.

📌 Category: Latest Jobs
🏛️ Sector / State: Govt (All India / Central)
🗓️ Release Date: 29 Oct 2026
📜 Notification Date: 29 Oct 2026
🔴 Last Date: 21 Nov 2026
📊 Total Vacancy: 28 Posts
🎓 Eligibility: Eligibility | Anatomy MD/DNB in Anatomy OR A) M.Sc/M.Biotech Degree in the subject concerned with B) Ph.D. in the subject concerned/allied subject
💳 Application Fee: Employment News | Anaesthesiology 5 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
🚀 Apply Online / Registration📄 Official Notification PDF🌐 Official Website

📋 COMPLETE POST DESCRIPTION & OFFICIAL DETAILS

📅 Important Dates
  • Post Release / Update Date: 29 Oct 2026
  • Notification Date: 29 Oct 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 21 Nov 2026
💳 Application Fee
  • Employment News
  • Anaesthesiology 5 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
  • Anatomy 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11); Rs. 56,100 (Level-10) for M.Sc with Ph.D
  • Community & Family Medicine 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
  • Dentistry (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
  • Dentistry (Prosthodontics) 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
  • ENT 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
  • Forensic Medicine & Toxicology 1 Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)
🎂 Age Limit & Relaxation
  • SC/ST 5 years
  • OBC 3 years
  • PwBD (General) 10 years
  • PwBD (OBC) 13 years
  • PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years
  • Fill the Annexure II proforma/check list, which also asks for total experience, research publications in indexed journals and the best 3 publications of the last 3 years in Vancouver style.
🎓 Eligibility Criteria
  • Eligibility
  • Anatomy MD/DNB in Anatomy OR A) M.Sc/M.Biotech Degree in the subject concerned with B) Ph.D. in the subject concerned/allied subject
  • Pharmacology MD/DNB in Pharmacology OR DM (Clinical Pharmacology) OR (a) M.Sc./M.Biotech Degree in the subject concerned, and (b) Ph.D in the subject concerned/allied subject
  • Additional duties may be assigned, with no extra allowance.
  • Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law, and any pending disciplinary proceedings must be reported in writing at document verification.
  • Date of birth certificate (10th certificate or birth certificate)
  • MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch marksheets and certificates, or other qualifying degree certificates
  • Attempt certificate for MBBS and post graduation

Dentistry (Prosthodontics)1Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11)

OBC41 each in General Surgery, Hospital Administration, Microbiology, Radiation Oncology
⚙️ Selection Process
  • Interview Results
  • Selection Process
  • Free AI Interview Tool
  • PwBD reservation is open to persons with not less than 40% physical disability, who must submit a Disability Certificate from a competent authority.
  • Document verification/interview (S.No. 01 to 20 departments) Will be intimated later
  • Document verification takes place before the interview, and the Screening Committee may shortlist candidates based on the verification of original documents.
  • Marks of the written test (if applicable) or interview are not displayed, and there is no re-checking or re-evaluation.
  • Interview turns may be delayed depending on the number of applicants.
📝 Exam Pattern & Syllabus
  • Cutoff Marks
  • Written Marks
  • Syllabus
  • Marks of the written test (if applicable) or interview are not displayed, and there is no re-checking or re-evaluation.
  • M.B.B.S/M.Sc/BDS marksheets and certificates, and the internship completion certificate
  • MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch marksheets and certificates, or other qualifying degree certificates
  • AEES Teacher Syllabus 2026
  • Kolkata Police Constable Syllabus 2026

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION STRATEGY

  • Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Core Syllabus): आधिकारिक सिलेबस (Official Syllabus) को डिकोड करें, Core Domain Subjects और State/General Studies के फाउंडेशन नोट्स तैयार करें और बुनियादी अवधारणाओं को मज़बूत करें।
  • Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Previous Year Question Papers (PYQs) के ट्रेंड को समझें, हाई-वेटेज टॉपिक्स पर विशेष पकड़ बनाएं और हर सप्ताह 3 विषयवार टेस्ट (Topic-wise Tests) देकर समय प्रबंधन सुधारें।
  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): अंतिम 30 दिनों में कोई नई किताब न छूएं—केवल अपने शॉर्ट नोट्स का रिविज़न करें, रोज़ाना 1 Full Mock Test दें और परीक्षा हॉल के टेम्परामेंट व एक्यूरेसी पर फोकस करें।

🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION STRATEGY

  • Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & High-Yield Revision): अंतिम 30 दिनों में कोई नई किताब न छूएं—केवल अपने शॉर्ट नोट्स का रिविज़न करें, रोज़ाना 1 Full Mock Test दें और परीक्षा हॉल के टेम्परामेंट व एक्यूरेसी पर फोकस करें।
